metadata.measurement_warning: Elapsed time measures local benchmark-method wall time, not model latency or production runtime. Existing baseline/memory results may be modelled from ground truth rather than independently executed. The legacy recovery_steps field counts strategy-specific internal recovery stages and is not yet normalized across every scenario; do not use it for cross-strategy cost claims without checking the scenario's operation definitions. tool_calls is reported separately.

metric_definitions.elapsed_ms: Local wall-clock time for the benchmark method; not production latency, model latency, or an end-to-end deployment measurement.
metric_definitions.recovery_steps: Legacy count of internal recovery stages reported by the scenario method, excluding tool_calls where the method does so. Its event granularity is not normalized across all strategies and scenarios, so it is descriptive rather than a universally comparable cost metric.
metric_definitions.tool_calls: Number of simulated/executed tool calls reported by the scenario method; modelled scenarios may report assumed counts.
